query:
INSERT INTO products (id, name, slug, description, price, categoryId, stockQuantity, imageUrl, featured, active) VALUES
(90001, 'The Alibi', 'the-alibi', 'She showed up looking like she wasn''t trying. That was the whole point.

The Alibi is a boxy cropped tee that sits just right — above the waist, below the radar. Relaxed through the shoulders, clean at the hem. The kind of shirt that makes people ask where you got it, and you just shrug.

Embroidered logo on the chest. Nothing else to prove.

MATERIALS:
• 100% combed ring-spun cotton, 180 GSM
• Pre-shrunk and garment-washed for a lived-in feel from day one
• Reinforced shoulder seams
• Chain-stitch embroidery

CARE:
• Machine wash cold, inside out
• Tumble dry low
• Do not bleach
• Iron on reverse if needed
• Gets better with every wash', 3900, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-cropped-tee-jmtLpHHmj9XLs3acr8md6X.webp', 1, 1),

(90002, 'The Confession', 'the-confession', 'For the days when you need to disappear into something warm and not explain yourself to anyone.

The Confession is an oversized hoodie built for hiding in plain sight. Dropped shoulders, deep kangaroo pocket, and FAKE printed across the chest in a red that doesn''t apologize. Heavyweight fleece that feels like a secret you''re keeping from the cold.

MATERIALS:
• 80% cotton / 20% polyester heavyweight fleece, 400 GSM
• Brushed interior for warmth without bulk
• Reinforced rib-knit cuffs and hem
• Metal-tipped drawstrings
• Screen-printed front graphic

CARE:
• Machine wash cold, inside out
• Tumble dry low — safe for the dryer
• Do not iron directly on print
• Do not bleach
• Shrink-resistant after first wash', 7500, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-oversized-hoodie-Hvdc3H8dA9BWPJGFVcAKhZ.webp', 1, 1),

(90003, 'The Understudy', 'the-understudy', 'She never gets top billing but she holds the whole outfit together.

The Understudy is a ribbed fitted tank that does the quiet work. Thick straps that stay put. A scoop neck that flatters without trying. And a single embroidered F on the chest — because subtlety is underrated.

Layer it under a blazer. Wear it solo. Either way, she carries the scene.

MATERIALS:
• 95% cotton / 5% elastane rib knit, 220 GSM
• Four-way stretch for a fit that moves with you
• Flatlock seams to prevent chafing
• Double-stitched hems
• Embroidered chest logo

CARE:
• Machine wash cold on gentle cycle
• Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry
• Do not bleach
• Do not iron on embroidery
• Shape recovers after washing', 2900, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-fitted-tank-4fP7K58hpUTMmejsMyUCJ6.webp', 0, 1),

(90004, 'The Getaway', 'the-getaway', 'Pockets for everything. Explanations for nothing.

The Getaway is a wide-leg cargo pant built for people who carry their whole life on them and still look put together. Six utility pockets, adjustable drawstring ankles, and a high-waisted fit that sits where it should. The kind of pants you throw on when you don''t know where the day is going but you want to be ready for it.

MATERIALS:
• 100% cotton ripstop canvas, 240 GSM
• Garment-dyed for a broken-in look
• YKK zipper fly with button closure
• Reinforced pocket corners and stress points
• Adjustable drawcord at ankle

CARE:
• Machine wash cold
• Tumble dry medium — dryer safe
• Iron on medium heat if needed
• Do not bleach
• Color deepens with wear', 8900, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-cargo-pants-SXuL8wEr33MHtvQc7JS8EB.webp', 1, 1),

(90005, 'The Closer', 'the-closer', 'Walk into the room like you already own it. Negotiate later.

The Closer is an oversized single-breasted blazer that blurs the line between boardroom and bar. Notch lapel, two-button closure, and a red satin lining that only shows when you roll the cuffs — because the best details are the ones you choose to reveal.

Pair with The Boardroom trousers for the full play. Or throw it over a tank and jeans. She works both shifts.

MATERIALS:
• 70% polyester / 28% viscose / 2% elastane suiting fabric
• Full red satin lining
• Padded shoulders for structure
• Interior welt pocket
• Horn-effect buttons

CARE:
• Dry clean recommended
• Spot clean with damp cloth for minor marks
• Steam to remove wrinkles — do not iron directly
• Store on a wide hanger to maintain shoulder shape
• Lining is machine washable if separated', 15900, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-blazer-bqdJb3Y4GoLTrB9wi8MivC.webp', 1, 1),

(90006, 'The Encore', 'the-encore', 'The one they keep asking you to wear again.

The Encore is a midi wrap dress in deep burgundy jacquard that moves like it has somewhere important to be. V-neckline, long sleeves, self-tie waist, and a flowing A-line skirt that hits mid-calf. Dressed up or dressed down, she always gets a second look.

The tonal floral jacquard catches light differently depending on how you move. Which is the whole point.

MATERIALS:
• 100% viscose jacquard, 160 GSM
• Self-fabric waist tie
• French seam finishing throughout
• Tonal jacquard floral pattern
• Lined bodice

CARE:
• Hand wash cold or machine wash on delicate
• Hang dry — do not tumble dry
• Iron on low heat on reverse side
• Do not bleach
• Steam for best results', 12900, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-wrap-dress-SRv3GmavmfAcmgLGNWQ4C2.webp', 0, 1),

(90007, 'The Rundown', 'the-rundown', 'For the mornings that start at the gym and end at the grocery store and somehow include a coffee meeting in between.

The Rundown is a slim-fit jogger that refuses to look like loungewear. Tapered leg, ribbed ankle cuffs, and a red drawstring detail at the waist that says yes, these are intentional. Deep side pockets that actually hold things.

MATERIALS:
• 80% cotton / 20% polyester French terry, 300 GSM
• Brushed interior for softness
• Elastic waistband with contrast drawcord
• Ribbed ankle cuffs
• Side seam pockets with reinforced openings

CARE:
• Machine wash cold
• Tumble dry low — dryer safe
• Do not bleach
• Iron on low if needed
• Holds shape wash after wash', 6500, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-joggers-bT4Dj4xibXd7sTMScswMc4.webp', 0, 1),

(90008, 'The Statement', 'the-statement', 'Two words. No apology.

The Statement is a relaxed-fit graphic tee with NOT SORRY printed across the front in red and black distressed type. Slightly oversized through the body, rolled cuff sleeves, and a weight that drapes without clinging.

Some shirts whisper. This one doesn''t.

MATERIALS:
• 100% combed cotton, 200 GSM
• Pre-washed for zero shrinkage
• Water-based screen print — soft hand feel
• Reinforced collar to prevent stretching
• Side-seamed construction

CARE:
• Machine wash cold, inside out
• Tumble dry low
• Do not bleach
• Do not iron directly on print
• Print stays vivid through 50+ washes', 4500, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-graphic-tee-dEPYA9bthw8hS5HoSqgvYj.webp', 1, 1),

(90009, 'The Exit', 'the-exit', 'Leave before they figure out you were never supposed to be there.

The Exit is a cropped satin bomber in dusty rose with black ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem. Front zip, side pockets, and a weight that''s just right for the hours between sunset and bad decisions. The satin finish catches light. The black trim keeps it grounded.

MATERIALS:
• Shell: 100% polyester satin
• Lining: 100% polyester taffeta
• Rib trim: 95% polyester / 5% elastane
• YKK front zipper
• Welt side pockets

CARE:
• Dry clean recommended
• Spot clean with damp cloth
• Do not machine wash — satin is temperamental
• Do not iron — steam only
• Store on a padded hanger', 13900, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-bomber-jacket-6TwemuEGsiwGzD4jCzTydw.webp', 0, 1),

(90010, 'The Boardroom', 'the-boardroom', 'High-waisted. Wide-legged. Zero tolerance for nonsense.

The Boardroom is a tailored wide-leg trouser in cream that makes every room feel like your office. Pressed center crease, side zip closure, and a clean silhouette that moves from desk to dinner without changing. Pair with The Closer blazer for the full power play.

MATERIALS:
• 68% polyester / 30% viscose / 2% elastane
• Full lining for drape and comfort
• Pressed center crease
• Side zip with hook-and-bar closure
• Belt loops for optional styling

CARE:
• Dry clean for best results
• Machine wash cold on gentle cycle if needed
• Hang dry — do not tumble dry
• Iron on medium with press cloth
• Steam to refresh between wears', 9900, 30004, 500, 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663244348328/mnC6672QxsyxZGLVMrqTHR/women-wide-leg-trousers-ao6RNbH26BrsRWtfGnCrA5.webp', 0, 1);
